gloss: full of motivation; raring to go; fired up

definitions.gloss: full of motivation; raring to go; highly motivated
definitions.explanation: Overflowing with eagerness and willingness to do something. Describes a state of being extremely motivated and enthusiastic about a task or challenge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}だ。
⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}で⟦{出社|しゅっしゃ}→出社：06155_shussha⟧してきた。
examples.english: All the new employees came to work raring to go.

examples.japanese: やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}で⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{惨敗|ざんぱい}→惨敗：08236_zanpai⟧だった。
examples.english: I went into the match full of motivation, but the result was a crushing defeat.

notes:
Composed of ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧ (motivation, willingness) + ⟦{満々|まんまん}→満々：25662_manman⟧ (brimming, overflowing). A vivid, expressive phrase commonly used in casual conversation.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧: motivation, eagerness — itself a common standalone word
- ⟦{満々|まんまん}→満々：25662_manman⟧: full to overflowing — used in other expressions like ⟦{自信|じしん}{満々|まんまん}→自信満々：19995_jishinmanman⟧ (brimming with confidence)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}で⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle something with great enthusiasm
- やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧: looking very motivated
- やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}で⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}する→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧: to set off raring to go

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意欲的|いよくてき}→意欲的：06262_iyokuteki⟧: ambitious, eager — more formal
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have motivation — less intense
- {張|は}り{切|き}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be fired up, enthusiastic — similar intensity
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧: having plenty of motivation — slightly less emphatic
